scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev -w @2do/api -- --port 5174 --strictPort" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs http://localhost:5174/api/health && npm run dev -w @2do/web -- --port 5173 --strictPort"
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy -w @2do/api && npm run deploy -w @2do/web
scripts.mcp:generate: npm run openapi && openapi-mcp-generator --input apps/api/openapi.json --output .generated/mcp --base-url http://127.0.0.1:5174 --transport stdio --default-include false --force
scripts.mcp:build: npm run mcp:generate && npm install --prefix .generated/mcp && npm run build --prefix .generated/mcp
